dataResetNotice.title: Good to Know
dataResetNotice.journal: The app could not read your reading journal. Your garden starts again from bare earth; your settings have not changed.
dataResetNotice.settings: The app could not read your settings. They are back to their starting values; your reading journal has not changed.
dataResetNotice.everything: The app could not read what it had saved. It starts again from scratch: starting settings and bare earth.

language.label: Language
language.deviceLanguageMissing: The app is not translated into your phone’s language yet. Choose one above.
language.restartNote: The writing direction will change the next time the app starts.

restartConfirm.title: Restart in English?
restartConfirm.message: The app restarts to show everything in English, left to right. Your progress is kept.

gender.label: I am
gender.note: So the app speaks to you properly. Your friends see it too.

notice.denied: Notifications are turned off for this app. To get your reminders, allow them in your phone’s settings.
notice.not-asked: Your phone has not asked yet whether this app may send you notifications. Until it does, your reminders cannot arrive.
notice.none-enabled: With no reminder on, the app sends you no notifications.

feedback.title: Sounds and Vibrations
feedback.note: Sounds stay quiet when your phone is on silent, and while the app listens to your recitation.

voiceDiagnostics.title: Voice Diagnostics
voiceDiagnostics.footer: What recognition saw on this phone. Nothing is sent.
